name: appsetting
sql:
CREATE TABLE appsetting (
	"key" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	value TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

name: curriculum
sql:
CREATE TABLE curriculum (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	confirmed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_curriculum_name_version UNIQUE (name, version)
)

name: modelusageevent
sql:
CREATE TABLE modelusageevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	input_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	output_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	thought_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	cached_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	estimated_cost_usd FLOAT, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

name: curriculumgenerationmetadata
sql:
CREATE TABLE curriculumgenerationmetadata (
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	goal TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_requirements TEXT NOT NULL, 
	topic_flags_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (curriculum_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: interviewsession
sql:
CREATE TABLE interviewsession (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	overall_score FLOAT, 
	duration_seconds INTEGER, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: track
sql:
CREATE TABLE track (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_track_curriculum_slug UNIQUE (curriculum_id, slug), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id)
)

name: interviewreport
sql:
CREATE TABLE interviewreport (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	report_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES interviewsession (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_interviewreport_session_id ON interviewreport (session_id)

name: topic
sql:
CREATE TABLE topic (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	priority INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_level VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	estimated_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_topic_track_slug UNIQUE (track_id, slug), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES track (id)
)

name: arenaproblem
sql:
CREATE TABLE arenaproblem (
	"key" VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	track VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	difficulty VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	topic_tags_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	mapped_topic_id INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY ("key"), 
	FOREIGN KEY(mapped_topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: attempt
sql:
CREATE TABLE attempt (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	used_hint BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: courselesson
sql:
CREATE TABLE courselesson (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	content_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_path VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_course_lesson_version UNIQUE (topic_id, content_version), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: dailyplanitem
sql:
CREATE TABLE dailyplanitem (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	plan_date VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	item_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	estimated_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: exercise
sql:
CREATE TABLE exercise (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	curriculum_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	track_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	prompt_markdown TEXT NOT NULL, 
	difficulty VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	generator_model VARCHAR, 
	generator_version VARCHAR, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	validation_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(curriculum_id) REFERENCES curriculum (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(track_id) REFERENCES track (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: learnertopicstate
sql:
CREATE TABLE learnertopicstate (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mastery_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	confidence VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_studied_at DATETIME, 
	last_tested_at DATETIME, 
	next_review_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id), 
	CHECK (mastery_score >= 0 AND mastery_score <= 100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: learningsession
sql:
CREATE TABLE learningsession (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	mode VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	ended_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: lessonsectionprogress
sql:
CREATE TABLE lessonsectionprogress (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	section_slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	completed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	first_viewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	last_viewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id, section_slug), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: mistake
sql:
CREATE TABLE mistake (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	occurrence_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_mistake UNIQUE (topic_id, category, description), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: reviewstate
sql:
CREATE TABLE reviewstate (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	state_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: topicmigrationmap
sql:
CREATE TABLE topicmigrationmap (
	old_topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	new_topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	mapping_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	migrated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (old_topic_id, new_topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(old_topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(new_topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: topicprerequisite
sql:
CREATE TABLE topicprerequisite (
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	prerequisite_topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (topic_id, prerequisite_topic_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(prerequisite_topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: arenaattempt
sql:
CREATE TABLE arenaattempt (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	problem_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	track VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	submitted_source TEXT NOT NULL, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	gave_up BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	hints_used INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	runtime_ms INTEGER, 
	result_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(problem_key) REFERENCES arenaproblem ("key")
)

name: arenahintuse
sql:
CREATE TABLE arenahintuse (
	problem_key VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (problem_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(problem_key) REFERENCES arenaproblem ("key")
)

name: chatmessage
sql:
CREATE TABLE chatmessage (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	role VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	chat_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id)
)

name: exerciseattemptdetail
sql:
CREATE TABLE exerciseattemptdetail (
	attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	answer TEXT NOT NULL, 
	hints_used_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	execution_summary_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	feedback TEXT NOT NULL, 
	grading_source VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	evaluation_status VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (attempt_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id)
)

name: interviewquestion
sql:
CREATE TABLE interviewquestion (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	section VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	competency VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	question_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	prompt_markdown TEXT NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER, 
	exercise_id INTEGER, 
	learning_session_id INTEGER, 
	follow_up_of_id INTEGER, 
	rubric_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	expected_concepts_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	difficulty VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	suggested_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	blueprint_slot INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	generated_by VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES interviewsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(learning_session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(follow_up_of_id) REFERENCES interviewquestion (id)
)

name: masteryevidenceevent
sql:
CREATE TABLE masteryevidenceevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	source_attempt_id INTEGER, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	evidence_weight FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	assisted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id)
)

name: practicehintuse
sql:
CREATE TABLE practicehintuse (
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, exercise_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id)
)

name: practicesessionexercise
sql:
CREATE TABLE practicesessionexercise (
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id, exercise_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id)
)

name: reviewevent
sql:
CREATE TABLE reviewevent (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER, 
	attempt_id INTEGER, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	fsrs_rating INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	previous_due_at DATETIME, 
	next_due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id)
)

name: transfercheck
sql:
CREATE TABLE transfercheck (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	topic_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	exercise_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	attempt_id INTEGER, 
	score FLOAT, 
	passed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	assisted BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(topic_id) REFERENCES topic (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(exercise_id) REFERENCES exercise (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_transfercheck_session_id ON transfercheck (session_id)

name: tutorsessionstate
sql:
CREATE TABLE tutorsessionstate (
	session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lesson_version VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	section_slug VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES learningsession (id)
)

name: interviewresponse
sql:
CREATE TABLE interviewresponse (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	question_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	response_text TEXT, 
	attempt_id INTEGER, 
	score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	evaluation_json TEXT NOT NULL, 
	answered_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	duration_seconds INTEGER, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(question_id) REFERENCES interviewquestion (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(attempt_id) REFERENCES attempt (id)
)
indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_interviewresponse_question_id ON interviewresponse (question_id)
